title: Dr. Ebere Ubesie
biography: Mrs. Ebere Ubesie is an accomplished finance professional with a strong academic background and extensive work experience. She is currently pursuing a Ph.D. in Accounting with a focus on machine learning applications in early detection of bank failures in Nigeria at the University of Johannesburg in South Africa. She holds an MSc. in Science and an MBA from the University of Nigeria Nsukka, Enugu Campus. She holds a Bachelor of Science degree in Accounting from the same university. She has certifications from the Association of Chartered Certified Accountants (ACCA) and the Institute of Chartered Accountants of Nigeria (ICAN). She has extensive work experience, including a current role as Deputy Manager (Head, Consumer Banking) at Zenith Bank Plc, Enugu Branch, where they provide a full range of financial services to clients and implement strategies to enhance loan selling. She has also held position at Zenith Bank Plc in Ogoja Branch, Cross River, as Head of Operations and finally as Senior Auditor at Abuchi Ed Ogbuju & Co in Abuja, FCT Nigeria. Additionally, She has volunteer experience serving on non-profit boards and as the National President of the Student Christian Movement of Nigeria.

title: Prof. Agozie Ubesie
biography: Dr Ubesie is a Senior Lecturer in the Department of Paediatrics and Associate Director, Institute of Molecular Medicine and Infectious Diseases (IMMID),College of Medicine, University of Nigeria. He is also an Honorary Consultant, Department of Paediatrics, University of Nigeria Teaching Hospital. His clinical and research interests have focused on paediatric gastroenterology, hepatology, nutrition and infectious diseases. He received his medical and post-graduate trainings in Nigeria and graduated from the University of Nigeria in 1998. Subsequently he did his post-graduate training in Paediatrics from 2002 to 2006 at the University of Nigeria Teaching Hospital, Enugu. He is a Fellow of the Medical College of Nigeria (FMCPaed) and the West African College of Physicians (FWACP) in the Faculty of Paediatrics. His career path has focused on public health issues affecting children in resource poor countries such as HIV and malnutrition. After his post-graduate training in Paediatrics in 2006, he joined the International Center for AIDS Care and Treatment Programs (ICAP), Columbia University as Pediatric Clinical Advisor and helped develop robust HIV services that have contributed to scale up of paediatric HIV services in Nigeria particularly in the area ART and PMTCT. He later became a Regional Team Leader for the Columbia University Program, supervising teams that worked with supported States in Nigeria to strengthen their health systems. In 2010, he returned to the University of Nigeria as a Lecturer in the Department of Paediatrics. In 2012, he was a Visiting Research Scholar at the Cincinnati Children’s Hospital Medical Center/University of Cincinnati. Dr. Ubesie was the winner of 2015, College of Medicine, University of Nigeria, Emeritus Prof. Chukwuedu Nwokolo’s Award for Excellence in Medical Practice and Research. He is an examiner of both Part-I and II candidates of the Faculty of Paediatrics, National Post-graduate Medical College (NPMCN) and currently sits in the Faculty Board of Paediatrics, NPMCN. He has also served an external examiner to some medical schools in Nigeria. Dr. Ubesie has presented scientific papers at local and international meetings and has over 50 peer reviewed publications to his credit.

biography: Serves on the board of directors of Jedidiah Cares Global Outreach for Women, Youth and Children.

title: Dr. Ebes Esho
biography: Dr. Ebes Esho is a Research Fellow of the University of Johannesburg, South Africa. She is also the founder and managing consultant at Bezalel Frontiers, and the Student Founders and Entrepreneurship Platform – an NGO that promotes and advances entrepreneurship endeavours amongst students. She was previously a resident postdoctoral research fellow at the University of Johannesburg and a lecturer at Covenant University, Nigeria. Dr. Ebes has many years of experience working in Nigeria’s banking industry with United Bank for Africa (UBA) and Zenith Bank Plc., She holds a bachelor degree with honours in accountancy from University of Nigeria, Nsukka, and an MBA, Mphil, and a doctorate degree in Management, with specialisation in business strategy, from Lagos Business School, Pan-Atlantic University, Nigeria. Dr. Ebes Esho has won several awards amongst which include awards from the Academy of International Business Africa (AIB-Africa) and the Academy of Management, United States.
